blurb: A slow hovering transport for six: a pilot, a rocket gunner and four passengers

notes.model: Ironbound Voyager (Meshy Community, CC0; the owner's Drive, Meshy_AI_Ironbound_Voyager_1110213418_texture.glb; content/guns.json vehicles/ironbound_hauler.glb, 2026-11-11; owner: "ironbound voyager is our new hauler"): an armoured hover freighter, a closed tube of a hull 1.8 m wide and 2.2 m tall with a tapering nose, a railed deck on its back half and six engine nozzles at the tail; 6.8 m long, fitted to the box's length. The Dispatcher it replaced is the fallback (vehicles/hauler.glb).
notes.half: Unchanged (the re-skin keeps handling): 3.2 m wide, so the hull and its side pods are inside it. The two thin fins amidships reach 2.76 m either side, outside the box: not solid, like the Tank's barrel.
notes.seats: Measured on the model (slices of its triangles; the mount's frame is the model's plus the 0.35 m it hovers): the roof 2.45-2.55 m up, flat with low rails 0.85 m either side from z -2.4 to 0.2. The pilot sits in the nose (cushion 1.0 m, z 2.3), out of sight in the closed hull; the rocket gunner stands on the deck (z -0.9, a standing place: they can duck); the four passengers sit on the deck's edges facing out, two a side (z -0.2 and -1.7), legs down the hull's shoulder, like the Buggy's deck riders. Roles and the gunner's rockets unchanged.
notes.cockpitEye: A seated head height in the nose. In your own cockpit view the nose's shell is cut away (client content/cockpits.ts, HAULER), so the pilot sees ahead.
